europe_now.title: Hungary Energy Crisis
europe_now.summary: Hungary has shut down its Paks nuclear plant due to a drought and high temperatures. This move has triggered an energy crisis across the country.

sources.headline: Amid a drought and soaring temperatures, Hungary shuts down its nuclear plant

europe_now.title: Ceuta Migration Crisis
europe_now.summary: Spain is dealing with the aftermath of a significant migration surge in Ceuta. The EU has responded to the situation as officials in Spain seek solidarity.
